description:
In this video, Unity’s Rambod Kermanizadeh outlines the strategic advantages and expansion of Unity IAP, emphasizing how it provides studios with greater control over their in-game economies and revenue streams. He also discusses production verifying the tech and working with SciPlay.

Learn more: unity.com/products/iap
